name: The Desired Affair
source:
A young man in his last year in school is determined to find love, romance, or at least get laid. When he manages to hook up with one of the hottest girls in school, his new girlfriend throws him a curve ball when she asks him: "could you sleep with other women for me?" This is the story of a boyfriend and his cuckquean girlfriend.​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/the-desired-affair-v0-1-vitalsigns.71529/]F95zone[/url]]

Further development of the title has been abandoned.
